addr: 45-190, Brigade Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Hands down the best place in Bangalore for vibe and nightlife! The street is always alive, especially on weekends. There are lots of stores for shopping.. you can find everything from big brands to local handicrafts. After shopping, just …

MG Road or mahatma gandhi road harbours every brand along it's streets. The floors on road are showrooms while the ones below them are usual shops with non branded clothes. Food joints can also be found... Parking spots are hard to find …
It's such an amazing place to wander in the evening time and also the best place for shopping lover ....all things at one place from locals to brands, everything all together.
